reply:
ribed.

What the data show: the rate rises strongly with t, and at fixed t it grows with P in a concave way. At P≈3 it is flat for t up to about 4, then climbs steeply. At P≈5 it is higher at t≈0.5 than at t≈2. A logistic-in-t factor helped most, but it still needed five terms and gave NMSE ≈ 0.009.
